destination.name: Dorrigo National Park
destination.tagline: Gondwana rainforest on a plateau above the Bellinger Valley, with a lookout and waterfalls.
destination.description: Dorrigo National Park protects one of the last rainforests left from Gondwana and is the most visited of the World Heritage Gondwana Rainforests of Australia. The Dorrigo Rainforest Centre is the visitor base, with the Skywalk lookout and the 5.8 km Wonga Walk past Tristania and Crystal Shower falls. The plateau town of Dorrigo has Dangar Falls just north of it, and Bellingen lies in the valley below on Waterfall Way.

goodToKnow.title: Allow time for Wonga Walk
goodToKnow.detail: The Wonga Walk is a 5.8 km rainforest loop; allow two to three hours, and set off in daylight.

goodToKnow.title: Rainforest Centre hours
goodToKnow.detail: The visitor centre is open 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM (to 3:30 PM June to August), and Wikivoyage lists a small donation for passing through it.

goodToKnow.title: A car is needed
goodToKnow.detail: Wikivoyage advises taking a car to the park; Dorrigo is about an hour from Coffs Harbour and 30 minutes from Bellingen via Waterfall Way.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the milder shoulder seasons for a plateau-top rainforest walk; this is an approximate guide rather than a sourced consensus, so check conditions before setting out.
